minecraft:written_book_content.title: Field Notes: Northern Cabin
minecraft:written_book_content.author: M. Vale
pages: {"text":"The stove was cold when we arrived. There were four cups on the table, but only three sets of tracks leaving the house."}
{"text":"Do not follow the fourth set into the trees. It does not disturb the snow."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The three-stroke mark appears again in the station ledger. Vale wrote that the outpost crew refused to carry anything bearing it."}
